hypothesis: A precise control/embedding contract with less integration burden; generic routing alone is already well served.
baseline_candidates: LiteLLM or direct provider clients for model traffic
Temporal for durable orchestration where justified
scenario: Benchmark two distinct workloads rather than a composite score. Model traffic: stream, failover, cancel and account. Process dispatch: spawn, observe, fail, restart and terminate actual tools under explicit scopes. Compare each with the simplest appropriate existing implementation.
failure_cases: Model retry rules incorrectly applied to side-effecting processes
